sentence: This project combines data sources to build a group of men and women and examine what affects survival from colon and lung cancers.
This project studies how signaling contributes to liver fibrosis, which can progress to cirrhosis and liver cancer.
This project tries to find out which proteins a key inflammatory kinase phosphorylates and which signaling pathways it influences.
This project tests whether the maturing of glutamatergic inputs to the nucleus accumbens determines how sensitive adolescents are to aversive outcomes.
This project studies a preclinical model of chronic urologic pelvic pain to find which targets alter the peripheral nervous system and lead to it.
This project uses mixed methods research to find out which factors shape cervical cancer prevention and how cancer control could improve.
This project studies how inherited mutations affect blood stem cells during aging, using patient samples and aged mice.
This project uses cryo-electron tomography and mass spectrometry to study why the HIV glycoprotein differs in structure between virus isolates.
This project studies how RNA editing of double stranded RNA affects the risk of coronary artery disease and atherosclerosis.
This project tests ways to improve outcomes after hematopoietic stem cell transplant, including a trial comparing two methods to reduce graft-versus-host disease.
This project runs a screening facility that tests genes and possible therapeutics in cell cultures, organoids, and whole organisms.
This project provides bioinformatics and data analysis services for biomedical research and builds tools and methods to speed up advances in the sciences.
This project studies how signaling by the mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 drives persistent inflammation and polyp growth in nasal polyps.
This project uses computer simulations and experiments to study how myosin motors carry out different functions, from muscle contraction to hearing.
This project studies how spatial and contextual factors affect the risk and outcomes of invasive fungal infections.
This project develops and tests vaccines that combine bacterial antigens to stimulate several types of immunity against multidrug-resistant bacteria.
This project studies whether neural oscillations tied to response inhibition relate to emotion regulation and impulsivity in bipolar disorder.
This project runs an imaging facility that gives cancer researchers imaging tools for small animals, including MRI and micro-ultrasound.
This project builds a tool that combines Raman microscopy, spatial multi-omics, and machine learning to map the molecular signatures of senescent cells.
This project uses elasticity imaging to monitor how breast cancer tumors respond to chemotherapy and ultrasound thermal ablation.
